title: prunus serotina subsp. eximia
intro: Prunus serotina subsp. eximia, commonly known as Black Cherry, is a subspecies of the Black Cherry tree, native to eastern North America. The bark and leaves of this plant have been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Black Cherry include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Black Cherry include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant actions, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as salicylic acid, flavonoids, and anthocyanins.
